title: Planck Window onto Parallel Universes: paper and analysis code
description: Paper and analysis code for version 3 of Preprints.org 202104.0350. The code measures, on the Planck 2018 temperature maps, which bubble-collision discs and cosmic textures the sky still allows: a targeted fit at the Cold Spot, a blind full-sky matched-filter search calibrated with Gaussian simulations, detection efficiency from injections, and the observable window as a function of angular size. No imprint is detected.
